action.intent: Inspect fortress status, population, and supplies before issuing initial work.
Close the status screen and return to the fortress map for site inspection.
Inspect the terrain under the current cursor before choosing an excavation site.
Inspect the eastern rocky slope for a safe mine entrance.
Move the look cursor west from open space onto the rocky slope to identify a diggable entrance tile.
Designate a downward stair into the exposed silty-clay hillside and allow a miner time to carve it.
Designate a downward stair in the subterranean silty clay wall at the current cursor, then let the miners work.
Exit designation mode, unpause the fortress, and let the miner attempt the designated downward stair.
Resume simulation long enough for the miner to complete the designated entrance stair, then inspect progress.
Inspect the level below to verify whether the staircase was mined and begin laying out the underground fortress.
Inspect the current tile and cursor location on the lower z-level before designating the underground fortress.
Exit look mode and designate a single upward stair at the aligned cursor so miners can connect this subterranean level to the downward stair above, then allow work time.
Exit designation mode, unpause, and let the miners act on the stair designation.
Inspect the level below the surface to verify whether the stair connection and mining designations exist.
Open the designation menu to inspect the pinned keys and establish a mine entrance.
Designate a single surface down-stair at the current cursor and let miners begin work.
Inspect the level directly below the designated surface down stair before laying out the underground entrance.
Designate a matching up/down stair on the level below the surface stair and allow miners time to connect the levels.
Designate a large underground starter hall immediately east of the stair tile, preserving the stair designation.
Confirm the large mining rectangle, leave designation mode, and let the miners begin excavating.
Inspect the level above to verify whether the underground mining area is connected by stairs.
Follow the visible downward passage at the cursor to inspect the level below and verify whether it connects to the stalled excavation.
Designate a horizontal access tunnel from the open edge into the solid underground rectangle.
Designate a short mining tunnel from the exposed west face into the solid rock, then let the miners begin excavating.
Resume the paused game so miners can carry out the designated tunnel, then allow time for excavation.
Open the designation menu and select mining so the tunnel can be designated from the cursor beside the rock.
Designate an initial 21-by-8 mining room inside the exposed rock.
Exit mining designation mode, unpause, and allow the miners to begin excavating the designated room.
Resume play and give the dwarves more time to begin the large accessible mining designation.
Inspect the unit list to identify professions and determine why no dwarf is mining.
Return to the map and inspect the unworked mining designation and current z-level.
Inspect the wall tile at the edge of the apparent mining designation to determine its terrain and designation state.
Inspect the adjacent solid tile to determine whether it is mineable stone or an impassable map boundary.
Exit Look mode and open the designation menu to begin laying out the first underground rooms.
Designate a large initial underground hall inside the soil/rock mass, connected directly to the open area at the current cursor.
Designate and begin mining the initial hall from the exposed cliff face.
Inspect the announcement for any mining cancellation or access problem before issuing more work.
Exit announcements and inspect the unit list to identify whether any settler has mining enabled or a miner profession.
Inspect the miner's unit details to verify labor, equipment, and status.
Open the selected miner's preferences menu to inspect whether mining labor is enabled.
Return from the biography/details page to the unit interface so mining labor and equipment can be checked.
Open the labor-management screen for the selected miner to verify and enable mining.
Exit labor management and inspect the fortress map and designation state.
Open the designation menu to begin a proper surface-to-underground staircase instead of trying to mine open surface terrain.
Designate a single downward stair on accessible surface terrain near the center of the visible map.
Complete the single-tile down-stair designation, leave designation mode, and let the miner begin digging.
Descend one z-level through the completed surface stair and inspect the layer below before designating the underground stair and rooms.
Open the designation menu so the underground stair can be designated at the current cursor position.
Designate a matching up/down stair on the underground tile beneath the surface stair.
Confirm the single-tile up/down stair designation on the underground stone layer, then inspect the result before laying out rooms.
Designate an eight-tile access corridor east from the stair, then a 13-by-11 initial underground hall, exit designation mode, and let the miner work.
Unpause the fortress so the miner can begin the designated stair, corridor, and hall excavation.
Inspect the surface stair tile and verify whether the underground mining designation is accessible.
Descend through the confirmed surface down-stair at map x40,y20 to inspect the exact tile below and diagnose the inaccessible mining designation.
Designate an up/down stair at the lower endpoint beneath the completed surface down stair, then allow the miner time to connect the levels.
Unpause and allow the miner time to complete the newly designated stair connection.
Unpause the fortress and allow the miner time to complete the designated stair connection.
Unpause and allow the miner time to complete the lower stair designation; then inspect progress.
Exit designation mode, unpause, and let the miner complete the lower stair.
Inspect the level below to verify whether the designated connecting stair has been mined.
Unpause and allow the miner time to complete the underground stair designation.
Descend one z-level to inspect whether the entry stair has been completed before laying out the fortress.
Open the mining designation and inspect the cursor position on the underground level before laying out the starter hall.
Designate and begin mining a compact 13x9 starter hall from the stair landing.
